title: Giant fourth-generation Propel testing protocol and stiffness results
notes: Current manufacturer test page identifies the fourth-generation 2027 Propel and publishes frame pedaling stiffness of 84 N/mm, torsional stiffness of 124 N/degree and fork stiffness of 60 N/mm. It describes the fixture, frame angle, dropout restraint and pedal-eye loading protocol; these are manufacturer results, not independent lab measurements.
